blocks.text: You can view and manage the dashboards that you have access to.
When managing dashboards, you can perform the following actions:

blocks.item: Edit a Dashboard Widget
To edit a dashboard widget:
In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Explore.
In the left-side navigation, click Dashboards.
Choose one of the following options:
Hover over the dashboard you want to edit, and click the Edit icon.
Select the checkbox next to the dashboard you want to edit, and click Edit at the top of the page.
Edit access depends on your permissions.
See image.
The Edit Dashboard page appears.
On the Edit Dashboard page, click the Edit Widget icon on a widget to edit it.
See image.
Make the necessary changes, and click Save.
See image.
Click Save on the Edit Dashboard page.
See image.
The dashboard widget is updated.
Edit Dashboard Details
To edit dashboard details:
In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Explore.
In the left-side navigation, click Dashboards.
Choose one of the following options:
Hover over the dashboard you want to edit, and click the Edit Details icon.
Click the dashboard, click the Edit Dashboard icon, then click the name of the dashboard.
Edit access depends on your permissions.
The Edit Dashboard Details window opens.
See image.
In the Edit Dashboard Details window, make the necessary changes. To learn more, see Configuring Custom Dashboards.
See image.
Close the window, and click Save to apply the changes.
Pin a Dashboard to an App

For quick and easy access to your dashboards, you can pin them to an app in the Agentic Security Operations Platform (Agentic SecOps Platform). Pinned dashboards are listed on the app's My Dashboards page.
To pin a dashboard to an app:
In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Explore.
In the left-side navigation, click Dashboards.
Choose one of the following options:
Hover over the dashboard you want to pin, and click the Edit Details icon.
Click the dashboard, click the Edit Dashboard icon, then click the name of the dashboard.
The Edit Dashboard Details window opens.
In the Pin to Apps drop-down menu, select the apps that you want to pin to the dashboard.
See image.
Close the window, and click Save to apply the changes.
To access a pinned dashboard in the app:
Go to the app where the dashboard is pinned (e.g., Vulnerabilities).
In the left-side navigation, click My Dashboards.
You can view the full list of the dashboards pinned to this app.
See image.
Apply Global Filters
To apply global filters to a dashboard widget:
In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Explore.
In the left-side navigation, click Dashboards.
Choose one of the following options:
Hover over the dashboard you want to edit, and click the Edit icon.
Select the checkbox next to the dashboard you want to edit, and click Edit at the top of the page.
Edit access depends on your permissions.
The Edit Dashboard page appears.
On the Edit Dashboard page, click Add Filters and apply the required filter conditions. To learn more, see Using Filters.
See image.
The filter only displays the entities used in the widget and the entities related to the widget. Only these entities can be used for filtering.
If the filter conditions do not apply to any widget on the dashboard, the dashboard displays a message indicating that filters cannot be applied.
If you delete a widget that has an entity used in a filter, that filter becomes inactive. You can remove the inactive filter or replace it with a filter for another widget.
See image.
